tasks.title: Twin Stars
paras: Stars form in the relatively dense,egg-shaped cores of molecular clouds made of dust and gases. Scientists mapping these dense cores must use radio waves to penetrate the dust and gases that prevent light from escaping molecular clouds; satellite images of these regions show nothing but large, black areas of space.

Recent observations of the Perseus molecular cloud may have surprising implications for previously accepted conclusions about the Sun. A radio wave sweep of the Perseus cloud's dense cores revealed that the youngest stars existing in the cloud all occurred in pairs,or binary twins,orbiting a common point. Stars of older binary systems, of which there were fewer, appeared closer together than stars of younger binary systems.

Scientists used current knowledge about stellar growth, decay, and destruction to predict the paths along which binary stars traveled throughout the molecular cloud. Their estimates would align with current understandings only if all stars approximately the same size as the Sun had begun as members of a binary system that first moved closer to each other and later separated. This rule would also apply to the Sun, whose twin likely separated following approximately one million years of coexistence.

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main point of the passage?

options.A: Binary stars alternate between separating and getting closer over time.
options.B: Star development takes place in the dense cores of molecular clouds.
options.C: The Sun formed in the same way that the Perseus molecular cloud did.
options.D: Stars the size of the Sun begin their development with a binary twin.

questions.analysis: 解析： 文章的核心论点在最后一段被明确提出：“Their estimates would align with current understandings only if all stars approximately the same size as the Sun had begun as members of a binary system...”。这句话总结了全文的发现：所有与太阳大小相似的恒星，在其形成初期都拥有一个双星伴星。这也适用于太阳。 选项分析： A 选项错误：文章提到双星系统 “first moved closer to each other and later separated”，并非交替进行。 B 选项错误：这只是文章开头的背景信息，不是主旨。 C 选项错误：文章是通过研究 Perseus 分子云来推断太阳的形成方式，并非说太阳和分子云形成方式相同。

questions.stem: The word"penetrate"in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 解析： "penetrate" 的意思是 “穿透、穿过”。文中提到 “Scientists mapping these dense cores must use radio waves to penetrate the dust and gases”，即科学家必须用无线电波 “穿透” 尘埃和气体才能绘制星核地图。选项 C “pass through”（穿过）与 “penetrate” 的含义最接近。 选项分析： A 选项 push aside（推开）强调动作，不如 “穿透” 准确。 B 选项 break apart（分解）不符合语境。 D 选项 travel around（绕着走）与原意相反。

questions.stem: Which of the following was most likely one of the "previously accepted conclusions" about the Sun?

options.A: It did not have a binary twin.
options.B: It is larger than most other stars.
options.C: It did not form in a molecular cloud.
options.D: It developed faster than most other stars did.

questions.analysis: 解析： 文章第二段提到 “Recent observations... may have surprising implications for previously accepted conclusions about the Sun.” 这表明新的观测结果挑战了过去的结论。新的结论是太阳曾经有一个双星伴星。因此可以推断，“previously accepted conclusions”（以前公认的结论）很可能与此相反，即认为太阳没有双星伴星。 选项分析： B、C、D 选项：文章均未提及这些是以前的结论。

questions.stem: What do the "estimates" discussed in the passage refer to?

options.A: The rate at which stars grow in the molecular cloud
options.B: The course that stars move along within the molecular cloud
options.C: The number of binary star systems found in the molecular cloud
options.D: The number of stars that have formed within the molecular cloud

questions.analysis: 解析：第三段提到 “Scientists... predict the paths along which binary stars traveled throughout the molecular cloud. Their estimates would align with current understandings only if...”。这里的 “estimates”（估计）指代的就是前一句提到的 “predict the paths”（预测轨迹）。“paths” 即 “the course that stars move along”（恒星运行的轨迹）。正确答案分析：their estimates 指代前文科学家对恒星运行轨迹、运动路线的预测。 选项分析： A. 恒星生长速率 —— 无关。 B. 恒星在分子云中的运行轨迹 —— 对应 paths，正确。 C. 双星系统数量 —— 错误。 D. 恒星形成数量 —— 错误。

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the passage about the Sun?

options.A: It is following a unique development pattern.
options.B: It moved closer to a binary twin early in its development.
options.C: It was too far from its twin to maintain the binary system.
options.D: Its twin decayed before separating from the binary system.

questions.analysis: 解析： 文章最后提到，研究发现的规律适用于太阳：“This rule would also apply to the Sun, whose twin likely separated following approximately one million years of coexistence.” 而这个规律在前一句被描述为 “a binary system that first moved closer to each other and later separated.”。因此可以推断，太阳在其发展早期也遵循了这一模式，即先靠近它的双星伴星。 选项分析： A 选项错误：文章明确指出太阳遵循的是一个普遍规律，并非独特模式。 C 选项错误：文章提到双星是 “later separated”（后来分离），原因并未提及是距离太远。 D 选项错误：文章没有提到伴星衰变。
